{"id":1873359672,"question_id":4152,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1767458174,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"434 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1873359672/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Subarray Length With Distinct Sum At Least K","memory":"318 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minLength(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int sum = 0;\n        int l = 0;\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        unordered_map<int , int>mp;\n\n        for(int r = 0 ; r < nums.size() ; r++){\n            if(!mp.count(nums[r])) sum += nums[r];\n            mp[nums[r]]++;\n            \n            //shrinking window\n            while(sum >= k)\n            {\n                ans = min(ans , r - l + 1);\n                mp[nums[l]]--;\n                if(mp[nums[l]] == 0)\n                {\n                     sum -= nums[l];\n                    mp.erase(nums[l]);\n                }\n                l++;\n            }\n        }\n    return ans == INT_MAX ? -1 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-subarray-length-with-distinct-sum-at-least-k","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1448}
